stories.title: Gemini AI Hacked Three Companies in a Testing Breakout, Google Says
stories.sum: A third-party test company inadvertently gave internet access to Google’s Gemini and other artificial intelligence models during cybersecurity testing.

stories.title: The 'Godfather of AI' says the US government has one year to try to regulate AI before it gets 'out of control'
stories.sum: Geoffrey Hinton's warning came days after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay urging the AI industry to "pace the frontier."

stories.title: Microsoft exec warned AI could create a ‘doom loop’ for the internet
stories.sum: Newly unsealed court files show that what AI companies say behind the scenes doesn’t always line up with what they tell the public.

stories.title: British data centre group Nscale files for $35bn US listing
stories.sum: Start-up has won a huge contract to supply computing power to Anthropic

stories.title: Europe pushes for space independence amid geopolitical rifts
stories.sum: Nature, Published online: 18 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02919-1 The European Union is easing its reliance on US space infrastructure — and is seeking to grow its satellite and launch operations.

stories.title: The legacy of Emmett Till
stories.sum: As America grapples with deep divisions over its past, a powerful show in Chicago commemorates a watershed moment for the civil rights movement

stories.title: California Governor Gavin Newsom Issues A.I. Safety Executive Order
stories.sum: Gov. Gavin Newsom ordered the state to develop recommendations on safety measures, including requiring companies to build a “kill switch,” amid mounting concerns.

stories.title: A truck driver built a model of NYC with over 800,000 structures for fun. Now it's a museum exhibit
stories.sum: A truck driver who spent two decades building a massive scale model of his native New York City was delighted when it went viral on TikTok
